answer: Because the lagoon decay is applied at each close, the prism audit makes public the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 17% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool hence watches its influence decay while paying the summit fee to keep them eligible. Honest users pay that once, farms 9 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
